_note: Proposed palette and type for Ross Towing. No logo or brand colors exist yet; swap these once Jennifer sends a logo. The same values are the CSS custom properties at the top of index.html.

amber.use: Primary safety color: call buttons, light bar, route line, highlights. Text on amber uses ink.

asphalt.use: Main dark background (night sections, header, footer)

paper.use: Light section background (freight, trust, service area)

ink.use: Text on light and on amber

signalRed.use: Hazard and tail lights in illustrations; never body text

placeholder.use: Background of [PLACEHOLDER] tags so unconfirmed facts are impossible to miss

display.use: Headlines, phone number, signs. Based on highway signage lettering, so it stays legible at a glance.

type.files: Self-hosted latin subsets in fonts/ (SIL Open Font License)

logo.placeholder: Text wordmark ROSS TOWING in Barlow Condensed 800 with an amber bar. Replace with the real logo file.
